summary: Web-only launch (oromona.com) tested end-to-end at desktop 1280x900 on https://fit-finder-app-5.preview.emergentagent.com. All 6 requested flows PASS: (1) Guest landing renders with headline 'The boutique that fits you.', Shop/Create account buttons and WebNav (Shop/Sign in/Get started) all present. (2) Guest /store shows 6 live marketplace cards, gender chips + category chips + search box all filter correctly (search 'wool' -> 1 card). (3) Item detail page shows WebNav on top; tapping Try It On and Buy as a guest both correctly route to /login and render login-submit-btn. (4) Buyer registration via UI blocked (missing DOB validation on submit — see minor issue), so a new buyer webbuyero8h8bmvs@example.com was created via POST /api/auth/register (fields: full_name, email, password, role='buyer', gender, dob). (5) Web login via /login with Shopping intent chip succeeded and landed at '/'; WebNav 'My account' shows. (6) FULL WEB CHECKOUT INITIALIZATION succeeded: adding a Nairobi address then tapping 'Continue to pay' called POST /api/payments/checkout -> 200 with body {session_id, url:'https://checkout.paystack.com/7v2167xi5okvusg'} AND a new browser tab opened to checkout.paystack.com. STOPPED at init per user instruction (LIVE Paystack keys). Zero console errors observed across all runs.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing testID on the primary 'Continue to pay' CTA in the checkout/address sheet — had to click by text. Add testID='checkout-pay-btn' for reliable automation.

ui_bugs.component: Address form 'Save & use' inside new-address subview
ui_bugs.issue: Only address-sheet-save-new is exposed; consistent naming (checkout-address-save) would help. Minor.

issues: Product column is centered/narrow (WEB_READ_WIDTH=760) with large empty margins on the sides on 1280px viewport — expected per boutique design, working as intended.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (from react-native-safe-area-context usage). Reference: /app/frontend/app/item/[id].tsx:467 SafeAreaView pointerEvents='box-none'. Non-blocking but should migrate to style.pointerEvents.
Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' Somewhere in RN styles — migrate to boxShadow for react-native-web parity.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID='checkout-pay-btn' to the 'Continue to pay' primary button in AddressPickerSheet for stable automation.

(Optional) Fix the web /register submit: when the user fills name/email/password but leaves DOB empty, no visible validation error surfaces — the button click silently no-ops. Either surface an inline error, or make dob truly optional (backend requires age OR dob).
(Optional) Migrate deprecated 'pointerEvents' prop to style.pointerEvents and 'shadow*' style props to boxShadow to clear web console warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Web landing/store gating via Platform.OS==='web' is clean and unobtrusive to native.
Guest gating on Try-On and Buy correctly bounces to /login (no unauthenticated attempts to /api/tryon or /api/payments/checkout).
Public catalog endpoints /api/items, /api/categories, /api/items/{id} all serve unauthenticated as intended.
Payment tab opens via new browser tab (react-native-web WebBrowser.openBrowserAsync -> window.open), and the returned checkout.paystack.com URL is valid.
seed_data_creation: Created one live buyer account via POST /api/auth/register: webbuyero8h8bmvs@example.com / Passw0rd!123 (role=buyer, gender=female, dob=1995-01-15). Also saved one delivery address (Home, Sunshine Court, A12 Kilimani, Kenyatta Avenue, Nairobi, Kenya, phone +254712345678) for that buyer. Did NOT complete Paystack payment — stopped at initialization as instructed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Buyer webbuyero8h8bmvs@example.com / Passw0rd!123 exists with a saved Nairobi address (Inner Nairobi zone, KSh 300 delivery). Camel Wool Overcoat (id 066a10cd-b0ca-41a6-9f21-4fa489c8dcf2, KSh 12,900) is a reliable in-stock test item on /store.
rca_of_issue: No blocking bugs found. Web landing + shoppable store + guest gating + login + checkout initialization all function correctly. Paystack checkout initialization confirmed with 200 response containing checkout.paystack.com URL and popup tab opening.
